title: Elodie and the Salt
author: Tamsin Dunmore
blurb: Ines Galloway, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
